methods.label: Powers, division, then addition
methods.explanation: First calculate the powers: \(-2^2=-4\) and \((-3)^2=9\); then perform the division: \(9\div(-3)=-3\); finally, \(-4+(-3)=-7\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 exponent notation, signed powers, and the standard order of operations.
